stop_history: Acceptance 2 says: if the backtest itself fills at the decision close, stop and report. The daily gate backtest and the pool admission replay fill at the decision bar close, so moving paper daily fills to the next session open would make paper diverge from the gate/admission convention, or changing the gate convention would invalidate approved baselines. Both need an operator decision.
